problems.title: big
problems.starterCode:
students = [
    ("Arun", 85, 78, 92),
    ("Bala", 67, 74, 81),
    ("Kavin", 91, 88, 95),
    ("Ravi", 72, 69, 76),
    ("Vijay", 88, 93, 84)
]

results = []
for name, m1, m2, m3 in students:
    total = m1 + m2 + m3
    average = total / 3
    results.append((name, total, average))

top_student = results[0]
for result in results:
    if result[2] < top_student[2]:
        top_student = result

print("===== STUDENT REPORT =====")
for name, total, average in results:
    print(name, "- Total:", total, "- Average:", round(average, 2))

print("==========================")
print("Top Student:", top_student[0])
print("Highest Average:", round(top_student[2], 2))
